categories.main_business_segments: Zhekuang Heavy Industry Co., Ltd. primarily operates in manufacturing mining, metallurgy, and construction specialized equipment, focusing on crushing and screening equipment and complete production lines. Its main business segments include sand and gravel (mining) processing equipment, metal mining processing equipment, and resource recycling equipment for solid waste such as construction waste and used batteries. The company also provides project investment, equipment supply, EPC+O full lifecycle services, and operation management services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced crushing and screening technologies including jaw crushers, cone crushers, gyratory crushers, impact crushers, hammer crushers, vibrating screens, feeders, and sand washing machines. It emphasizes energy-efficient, environmentally friendly, intelligent, and integrated equipment design. The company has developed proprietary technologies such as independent water circulation systems for battery recycling equipment and intelligent mining management systems enabling automated equipment operation and real-time monitoring.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the sand and gravel aggregate industry, metal mining industry (especially iron ore and non-ferrous metals), and environmental resource recycling sectors including construction waste and used battery recycling. Major end markets include infrastructure construction, real estate, metallurgy, and environmental protection. The company serves leading domestic battery manufacturers and waste disposal enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing in Zhejiang Province. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and operations in Cambodia, Hong Kong, Guyana, Indonesia, Zimbabwe, and other countries, focusing on mineral-rich regions and Belt and Road countries. Overseas markets include Southeast Asia, Africa, and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhekuang Heavy Industry operates mainly in the midstream segment of the mining equipment supply chain, manufacturing and supplying core crushing and screening machinery and complete production lines. It also extends downstream by providing project operation management and integrated service solutions, moving towards a comprehensive service operator role.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in energy-efficient, intelligent, and environmentally friendly mining equipment. Key R&D projects include automated dismantling and recycling of lithium-ion batteries, high-efficiency lead-acid battery recycling systems, advanced crushing equipment like high-capacity gyratory crushers, modular crushing and screening units, and intelligent construction waste recycling systems. It aims to expand equipment applications, improve product performance, and support green mining and circular economy initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of crushing and screening equipment, complete production lines, and related parts. The company also earns income from operation management services and aftermarket support. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales with some dealership channels, with payment terms involving deposits, progress payments, and retention for quality assurance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhekuang Heavy Industry is positioned as a leading domestic mid-to-high-end mining equipment manufacturer with competitive advantages in energy efficiency, intelligent automation, and integrated solutions. It competes with other Chinese mining machinery manufacturers such as Nanchang Mining Machinery. The company leverages its technology, product quality, and full-process service capabilities to maintain a strong market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 653 million, a 19.19% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 79.87 million, a 25.36% decrease. Total assets reached RMB 2.36 billion, up 8.56% from the previous year. The company has shown steady revenue growth but faces profit margin pressure due to market conditions. It maintains a solid asset base and continues investing in R&D and overseas expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes providing high-performance, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly mining equipment with intelligent automation capabilities. Its products feature advanced crushing and screening technologies, modular design, and integrated intelligent management systems that improve operational efficiency and reduce costs. The company offers comprehensive turnkey solutions and lifecycle services, differentiating itself through technological innovation, quality, and strong customer support.
